_doc: Opaque function words: no picture can show them. They get a hand-drawn SVG glyph at assets/symbols/<word>.svg, never an AI-generated picture; scripts/art/gen.mjs refuses these words. Owner: docs/operations/art-generator/SKILL.md § 1.2. source: asl = drawn from the ASL sign; symbol = a symbol the child meets anyway; diagram = arrow/dot/block geometry. parts: how many separate pieces the glyph has; separate pieces keep a clear gap (checked by scripts/art/gen.test.mjs). Omitted where pieces overlap by design (the spotlight, the dashed outline).

can.spec: Two fists (ASL S-hands) with green arrows moving down: the ASL sign CAN.

is.spec: One grey ball, then a green equals sign: one thing is.

are.spec: Three grey balls, then a green equals sign: many things are.

am.spec: A small yellow person (me), then a green equals sign: I am.

was.spec: The 'is' glyph with the past badge (rewind ◀◀) above.

were.spec: The 'are' glyph with the past badge (rewind ◀◀) above.

will.spec: Green fast-forward (▶▶): it is going to happen.

would.spec: The 'will' fast-forward, pale fill and dashed outline: maybe it will.

and.spec: Grey ball + grey block with a bold pink plus between: this and that.

or.spec: Pink fork: one path splits to a grey ball or a grey block. Pick one.

but.spec: Pink U-turn arrow: going one way, then turning back.

because.spec: Three falling dominoes; the first (the reason) is pink.

so.spec: Three falling dominoes; the last (the result) is pink.

if.spec: Pink decision diamond with a path in and two paths out.

to.spec: Pink arrow ending at a black dot: toward a place or thing.

for.spec: Pink arrow ending at a yellow person: for someone.

at.spec: Pink dot inside camera-focus corners: right at this spot.

of.spec: Grey pie with one pink slice pulled out: a piece of the whole.

a.spec: Row of three blocks, one pink: any one of them.

an.spec: Same glyph as 'a' (same word, different spelling).

the.spec: The 'a' row with a spotlight on the pink block: that specific one.
